一项评估 BW-40202 在中国健康受试者中单次给药和 IgA 肾病患者中多次给药的安全性、耐受性、药代动力学和药效学的 I/IIa 期研
究
lead_institution: 上海市徐汇区中心医院
sponsor_en: Shanghai Bowang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
executive_summary:
**Candidate & Modality:** BW-40202 Injection (Injectable Therapeutic), developed by Shanghai Bowang Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd..

**Target Indication:** Investigated for The kidney disease.

**Study Protocol & Design:** Phase I clinical evaluation enrolling an estimated 30-100 participants.

**Clinical Setting:** Conducted across accredited clinical research centers (Xuhui District Central Hospital, Shanghai) under China CDE supervision.
